integrations.name: Neatlogs
integrations.role: Agent runtime observability and application trace evidence
integrations.headline: SDK verification is complete for seven original V1 and five original V2 cloud traces; two original V2 traces remain partial, two separate fresh V2 traces are complete, and the required dashboard link or screenshot is pending.
integrations.detail: OpenAI-client calls from the Python run/evaluate CLI are instrumented with Neatlogs SDK 1.4.26. Workflow, model, tool, error, and trace identity evidence is saved. The infeasible-policy comparison shows V1 VERIFIED versus evaluator BLOCKED (17 spans, 7 model, 8 tool) and V2 BLOCKED versus evaluator BLOCKED (5 spans, 1 model, 2 tool). A V2 recovery trace contains a restart_service ERROR followed by successful restart and rollback/reverify (20 spans, 8 model, 10 tool). This satisfies scoped SDK trace verification only; local JSON and trace IDs do not fulfill the official project-trace link/screenshot format. T3's app.neatlogs.com destination redirected to sign-in; no authenticated dashboard is available. A human with dashboard access must supply the permalink, screenshot, or official share link. Public CLI OAuth is unverified.

integrations.name: Entire
integrations.role: Local coding-agent checkpoints and source graph retrieval
integrations.headline: A genuine local checkpoint maps an isolated audit-development session to commit 429769a; local Graph output retrieves final-source infeasibility logic.
integrations.detail: Checkpoint 01M4P5F42NEWP4TDWNFHWZVR2R is locally verified, with explicit limits: it covers one isolated worker, not the main session or all refinements. Final-source Graph evidence is associated with migration source aa5777b. No hosted GitHub App authentication, hosted checkpoint link, automatic hook capture, raw transcript upload, token-savings measurement, or performance improvement is claimed.

integrations.name: cfo.ai
integrations.role: Business-plan review and measured inference-cost reconciliation
integrations.headline: Reviewed six visible model pages and 39 Main Scenario months; reconciled final-study V2 inference at $0.3992516 across seven attempts, without editing or exporting the shared plan.
integrations.detail: The user-shared plan assumes enterprise and midmarket three-month pilots of $60,000 and $25,000, ACVs of $240,000 and $90,000, and a hypothetical $1.5 million opening cash balance. It shows a $96,355 September 2028 minimum and 31.7 months starting runway. Final-study estimated inference is $0.05703594 per attempt and $0.0998129 per verified non-no-op migration across four migrations; these are estimates, not invoices or full delivery COGS. Revenue, customers, conversions, costs, and financing remain planning assumptions. The shared model still contains a $6 inference placeholder and a PENDING measured field. Browser review, not API/export or formula audit.

study_result.recovery: V1 and V2 each recovered in 2/2 seeded recovery cases.
limitations: One repetition is not statistical evidence of superiority or production accuracy.
The fixed script is fixture-specific, matches V2 on these cases, and costs no inference.
Two historical V2 cloud traces remain partial; separate fresh V2 traces are not substituted into the matched study.
